sql:
SELECT
    property_id,
    parcel_identifier,
    property_cid,
    address_street,
    address_city,
    address_zip,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    subdivision,
    neighborhood_code,
    property_type,
    property_usage_type,
    built_year,
    livable_floor_area,
    total_area,
    residential_units,
    roof_year_est,
    roof_age_years,
    roof_age_basis,
    roof_covering_material,
    assessed_value,
    market_value,
    land_value,
    taxable_value,
    owner_name,
    owner_count,
    owner_occupied,
    owner_region_class,
    owner_mailing_address,
    owner_mailing_city,
    owner_mailing_state,
    owner_mailing_zip,
    homestead_flag,
    last_sale_date,
    last_sale_price,
    years_since_last_sale,
    tenure_basis,
    water_view_flag,
    water_dist_m,
    water_body_name,
    nearest_transit_stop_m,
    nearest_transit_stop_name,
    has_permits,
    permit_count,
    roof_permit_count,
    last_permit_date,
    source_system,
    source_url,
    fetched_at,
    run_id,
    source_artifact,
    source_sha256,
    CASE WHEN years_since_last_sale IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN years_since_last_sale < 10 THEN 0 ELSE least(1.0, 0.6 + 0.4 * least(1.0, (years_since_last_sale - 10) / 15.0)) END AS comp_tenure,
    CASE WHEN roof_age_years IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN roof_age_years < 15 THEN 0 ELSE least(1.0, 0.6 + 0.4 * least(1.0, (roof_age_years - 15) / 15.0)) END AS comp_roof,
    ((CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(owner_occupied, false) AND owner_mailing_address IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(homestead_flag, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2.0) AS comp_distress,
    round(100.0 * (3 * comp_tenure + 3 * comp_roof + 3 * comp_distress) / 9, 1) AS match_score
  FROM properties
  WHERE property_type = 'RESIDENTIAL'
  AND years_since_last_sale >= 10
  AND roof_age_years >= 15
  AND (NOT coalesce(owner_occupied, false) AND owner_mailing_address IS NOT NULL AND (owner_mailing_city IS DISTINCT FROM address_city OR owner_mailing_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'FL'))
  AND NOT coalesce(homestead_flag, false)
  ORDER BY match_score DESC, assessed_value ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0
